rationale: Detuned for ~23s delay and made it adaptive. Removed derivative (kd=0) which amplifies delayed phase. Lowered base gains to kp=0.38/ki=0.016 with ff=0.52 and tight integral limits, added slow setpoint ramp and strict u rate limit. Added online long-delay detector (12s progress window) that latches to kp=0.16/ki=0.006, ramp 0.012/s and 0.04/s rate limit when error persists without y progress, and releases after 15s of small error. Kept high-y safety clamps with fast cut bypassing rate limit. This directly targets delay-induced overshoot/limit-cycle while preserving nominal rise.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir y in [0,1], u in [0,1]. Nominal: first-order + 2-4s cold delay +5-10s lag, K~1.15, T~20-25s, hold-u for y=0.6 ~0.50-0.55, noise +-0.01. Changed: pure delay increased to ~23s (22-24s measured E13/E14) with similar K and drain. Requires wc<0.02 rad/s, no D, slow I, rate-limited PI + feedforward.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal (no change): reaches 0.55-0.65 in ~12-22s from mid starts, MAE ~0.02-0.03, in-band >=0.70 after 30s, no overrides. Delayed (~23s): no 0.9 hits or sustained limit cycle; after 12s detector latches to low gains, u holds ~0.5-0.7 without saturation, y climbs after ~23s lag and settles slowly to band in ~80-130s with in-band >>0.16 and MAE <<0.20, energy lower than before.
extra.diagnosis: Response is much slower / longer pure delay with intact gain. E13: step 0->0.5 at 202.5 shows zero rise for full 15s (stays at 0). E14 continuation shows first sustained rise only at ~225.6-226.5, i.e. 23.1-24.0s after the 202.5 step, rising 0.016 to 0.108 in 6s (~0.015/s) similar to nominal 0.012-0.025/s. E12 switch 0.96->0 at 162.5 falls to 0.15 then re-rises 173-184.9 to 0.44 (+0.28) 10.5-22s later from prior u in flight, then decays. Original cold delay was 2-4s (E3/E9). New delay ~22-24s (~6-10x). Gain/outflow/sensor unchanged: rise slope intact, no faster u=0 decay, no offset/noise change beyond 0-clipping.
